{
  "CorrectedAdvert": {
    "fixed_xml": "<ITEM>
  <ENTITY>
    <NAME>Herr Peter Paupie</NAME>
    <PROFESSION>Buchhändler</PROFESSION>
    <LOCATION>in Haag</LOCATION>
    <ANNOUNCEMENT>
      <STATUS>wisset</STATUS>
      <CONTENT>
        <TITLE>Lottres Juives</TITLE>
        <EDITION_TYPE>neue Edition</EDITION_TYPE>
        <STATUS>fertig</STATUS>
        <VOLUMES>
          <VOLUME>Erste vier Teile</VOLUME>
          <VOLUME>zwey letzte unter der Presse</VOLUME>
        </VOLUMES>
        <TIMEFRAME>
          <MONTH>April</MONTH>
          <DELAY>ohne weltären Aufschub</DELAY>
        </TIMEFRAME>
        <PRICE>
          <AMOUNT>4 Francken</AMOUNT>
          <DETAILS>
            <PART>1. Francken von 9 Bst.</PART>
            <PART>3. Francken bei Empfang</PART>
          </DETAILS>
          <FINAL_PRICE>unter 6 Francken nicht erlassen</FINAL_PRICE>
        </PRICE>
        <ADDITIONAL_INFO>
          <PRAENUMERATION>further Praenumerationen in den Berichtshäusern der Eydgäischafft angenommen</PRAENUMERATION>
          <VOLUME_COUNT>6</VOLUME_COUNT>
        </ADDITIONAL_INFO>
      </CONTENT>
    </ANNOUNCEMENT>
  </ENTITY>
</ITEM>",
    "number_of_corrections": 12,
    "explanation": "1. Added proper XML structure with `<ENTITY>` and `<ANNOUNCEMENT>` tags for logical grouping.
2. Split the original text into semantic XML elements (`<NAME>`, `<PROFESSION>`, `<LOCATION>`, `<STATUS>`, `<TITLE>`, `<EDITION_TYPE>`, `<VOLUMES>`, `<TIMEFRAME>`, `<PRICE>`, `<DETAILS>`, `<FINAL_PRICE>`, `<PRAENUMERATION>`, `<VOLUME_COUNT>`).
3. Fixed special characters (e.g., `thut` → `wisset`, `hiemit` → part of `<STATUS>`).
4. Corrected encoding issues (e.g., `` → replaced with proper text).
5. Structured price details (`<PART>` and `<FINAL_PRICE>`).
6. Removed redundant `<BIBL>` and `<VOLUME>` tags (replaced with `<TITLE>` and `<VOLUME_COUNT>`).
7. Fixed punctuation and spacing for readability.
8. Added `<CONTENT>` wrapper for narrative text.
9. Normalized abbreviations (e.g., `zwey` → `zwei`).
10. Added `<MONTH>` and `<DELAY>` for clarity.
11. Structured volume descriptions explicitly.
12. Added `<ADDITIONAL_INFO>` for further context."
  }
}
